name: js-semver
instruction: Implement semver.js (CommonJS): module.exports = compare. compare(a, b) compares semantic versions, returning -1, 0 or 1. Compare major, minor, patch numerically (so 1.10.0 > 1.9.0). A version WITH a prerelease is LOWER than the same version without one (1.0.0-alpha < 1.0.0). Prerelease identifiers compare dot-part by dot-part: numeric parts numerically, non-numeric lexically, and a numeric part is lower than a non-numeric one. Build metadata after '+' is IGNORED. Throw a TypeError on a malformed version.
